questions.text: If the net external force on a moving object is zero, what happens to its velocity?
options: It remains constant in magnitude and direction

questions.text: A heavy book rests on a table. Which pair represents Newton's 3rd Law pair?
options: Gravity pulling down & Normal force pushing up
Book pushing the table & Table pushing the book
Weight of the book & Air resistance

questions.text: Why do passengers jerk forward when a bus suddenly hits the brakes?
options: Their upper body continues in forward motion due to inertia
Air friction inside the cabin increases
